text:
sara: FYI customer NeuroNote is asking for an Optimize autosuggest pilot: console recommendations for batching+cache + eval-triggered alerts. They want a pilot for clinical extraction in ~6 weeks.

ben: 6 weeks doable if we limit scope. MLP = rule-based batching (no control loop), simple prefix/KV cache toggles + telemetry, eval alerts surfaced read-only in Console. No quantization recs for phase 1.

ella: Need acceptance targets from customer: latency SLOs (p95/p99), and which quality metric to monitor. Also ask for at least 1k labeled eval examples or permission to run sentinel probes.

sara: They want p95 < 300ms for short-form extracts and will flag if summary-F1 drops >3%. They can provide 800 labeled examples now, will try to push to 1k.

ben: Implementation note: batching heuristic = token-length buckets + static per-bucket max + runtime guard that drains early if latency approaches budget. Fallback to sync path. Example config: ```json {"optimize":{"batching":{"buckets":[64,256,1024],"max_batch":[16,8,4],"latency_budget_ms":300},"cache":{"prefix_ttl_s":30,"kv_enabled":true}}}```

chen: Ops: pilot on Dedicated mixed GPU pool. We must enforce per-GPU batch caps and ensure p99 < 700ms. Add metrics: batch_size_histogram, cache_hit_rate, per-route eval_signal_count. infra-bot: open ticket to add `optimize_v2` tag to metrics schema.

infra-bot: ticket INF-5333 opened to add optimize_v2 tag. ETA 4d.

ella: Eval alerts design: signals = sentinel failures + embedding drift + automated ROUGE regression on sample set. Alert if weighted score > threshold for 3 windows (window=500 requests). Show signal breakdown in Console.

ben: Timeline (condensed): week1 infra tag + eval hook, week2 implement heuristic batching & cache toggles, week3 add telemetry + Console surface, week4 staging smoke + invite customer for pilot, week5-6 iterate. We can trim if customer provides eval set early.

sara: Acceptance gates: 1) batching live and p95 visible in Console; 2) cache toggles usable and token-savings measured; 3) eval alerts appear with breakdown and link to evaluation job; 4) customer sign-off on metrics and thresholds.

ella: Risks: noisy alerts from small datasets, traffic mismatch. Mitigate via human acknowledgment step and cooldown.

chen: Ops action: reserve Dedicated slice for pilot weeks 4-6. infra-bot: create runbook stub for eval alerts.

infra-bot: runbook RUN-2120 created. Steps: acknowledge -> run eval job -> compare to baseline -> flag model owner -> switch batching to conservative mode if emergency.

sara: I'll request NeuroNote's traffic_profile.csv and eval_labels.csv, and send them the pilot acceptance doc. Ben, can you draft the Console copy for recommendation exports?

ben: Yup, will post a short mock by EOD.

sara: Thanks all. We'll aim to keep phase 1 tightly scoped; phase 2 adds ML-driven controller and quant recs. :thumbsup:
